Only our A-wings are capable of matching it in dogfights.|[[Antoc Merrick]] in ''[[The Rebel Files]]''|''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''}} The '''TIE/IN interceptor''', also known as the '''TIE Interceptor''', or '''TIE/in''' was a type of [[TIE series|TIE fighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]], most notably during the [[Battle of Endor]]. The [[interceptor]] was identifiable by the addition of four arrow-shaped panels tipped with [[laser cannon]]s. They were nicknamed "'''Squints'''" due to their narrow shape. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|Interceptors are a lot tougher than TIE fighters.|Din Djarin|{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}}} [[File:VeteranWingLeader-EpicBattles.png|thumb|left|250px|A TIE interceptor wing]] The TIE/IN interceptor''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' or TIE/in''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' was a far deadlier opponent than the standard [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]] and featured four very recognizable pointed [[Solar collector|solar panels]]. These panels, based on the "bent-wing" configuration used on the [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced|prototype TIE Advanced]] flown by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], were given a dagger like design, which gave a [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] a wider field of vision.[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] ===Engines and power=== Lacking both [[Deflector shield|shields]] and a [[hyperdrive]], the TIE/in made up for its lack of defensive capabilities with a top speed of 1,250 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]] owing to enlarged [[P-s5.6 twin ion engine]]s as well as an [[autothruster]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2021/2/15/reinforcements-of-renown|text=Reinforcements of Renown}} providing considerably improved maneuverability and speed. In order to achieve optimal performance and collect as much power from the enlarged solar panels, Sienar also equipped the TIE/in with an SFS [[I-a3a solar ionization reactor]], whose extra power allowed pilots to overclock their engines and execute tight turns and rolls not possible in most other starfighters. ===Armament===
[[File:SensitiveControls-SWZ.png|thumb|left|250px|The cockpit and controls of a TIE interceptor]]
Despite the LS-series hardpoints on the cockpit being intentionally left empty to reduce weight, four [[L-s9.3 laser cannon]]s on the TIE/in's wingtips allowed for far more firepower to overload the shields on an enemy craft. Binocular scanner modules were also placed in the midline of the TIE/in's engines, creating an overlapping stereoscopic field for the [[targeting computer]] which ensured that the weapons were unlikely to miss once locked on. With the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] placing its elite [[pilot]]s into Interceptor [[cockpit]]s to maximize the craft's effectiveness, interceptors were ideally suited for their main function: chasing down and eliminating rebel [[starfighter]]s. ==History== ===Time of the Empire=== ====Development==== [[File:Skerris-interceptor.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vult Skerris' prototype TIE/IN featured red and grey markings.]] The TIE Interceptor was developed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] as an alternative to the [[TIE Advanced x1]], which was determined to be too costly to mass-produce.''[[Star Wars: Ships of the Galaxy]]'' Heavily influenced by other Sienar bent-wing prototypes, such as the [[TIE/ad v1]]{{BuildFalconCite|33|Starship Fact File}} which was tested on [[Lothal]] by [[Baron of the Empire|flight baron]] [[Valen Rudor]],{{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}} the TIE/IN was stripped of the Advanced's hyperdrive and equipped with heavier weapons. To achieve an improved fight performance, Sienar also removed the [[L-s1 laser cannon]]s from the standard hardpoints in the cockpit module and reduced the armor. A [[TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype|prototype TIE/IN]] was developed by [[14 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' and tested by the [[Inquisitorius]]' [[Second Sister]]''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' who also used it on [[Bracca]] to investigate reports of a surviving [[Jedi]]. Another TIE/IN was present on the [[Occupation of Kashyyyk|Imperial-occupied]] planet [[Kashyyyk]] during that time.''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' The TIE/IN soon entered production in the Sienar factories as the third full-production [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] variant after the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE/ln]] and the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa]]. In [[3 BBY]], the Empire began to officially field TIE Interceptors{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/253434/developer-insights-tie-in-interceptor-prototype|text=Developer Insights: TIE/IN interceptor Prototype}} to serve as the Empire's direct response to the faster [[starship]]s introduced by the then-informal{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}} [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Nonetheless, it was not as fast as the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], being 50 kph slower. The improved TIE units were distributed to elite starfighter squadrons, including the [[128th Fighter Group]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing]], while some were offered to the commanders of TIE/ln squadrons as their personal starfighter. ====Operational history==== [[File:TIEInterceptor-CtSGSV.png|thumb|right|270px|TIE/IN famously featured at the Battle of Endor.]] Three TIE Interceptors carried out the [[massacre near Teralov]].{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}} The first confrontations between the Rebellion's [[T-65A2 X-wing starfighter|X-wing fighters]] and the Empire's TIE interceptors came with the [[Battle of Turkana]].{{BuildFalconCite|34|Secrets of Spaceflight}} [[General]] [[Weir]] flew a TIE interceptor.''[[Star Wars: Starfighter Missions]]'' When defecting Imperials [[Jon Melton]] and [[Bevelyn]], who were both secretly agents of [[Crimson Dawn]], sought to [[Mission to reveal the Death Star II|reveal the existence of]] the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] by escaping aboard the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Scopium]]'', three TIE interceptors were deployed from the [[Death Star]] and chased after the defectors. However, they managed to escape.[[Star Wars (2020) 27|''Star Wars'' (2020) 27]] Some interceptors belonging to elite pilots featured additional red and dark grey markings.{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}} In [[2 BBY]],''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "The Antilles Extraction" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," it must also take place in 2 BBY. [[Vult Skerris]] flew one of these starfighters, when he was based at [[Skystrike Academy]]. TIE Interceptors also took part in the [[battle against Crimson Dawn]][[Hidden Empire 1|''Hidden Empire'' 1]] and the [[Battle at Amaxine Station]]. A group of [[Unidentified crimson TIE/IN interceptor variant|crimson interceptors]] escorted the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] carrying Imperial leaders [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] into the station.[[Hidden Empire 4|''Hidden Empire'' 4]] By the [[time]] of the [[Battle of Endor]], the TIE Interceptor made up one-fifth of the Empire's starfighter fleet.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' [[Nash Windrider]] piloted a TIE Interceptor during the [[Battle of Jakku]].{{FFGXW2|set=Skystrike Academy Squadron Pack|cardname=Nash Windrider}} ===Era of the New Republic=== {{Quote|Something's coming up on us fast. It looks like a squadron of TIE Interceptors.|Bo-Katan Kryze, to Din Djarin|}} [[File:GideonTIEinterceptorDestroyed-Ch19TheConvert.png|thumb|left|270px|TIE Interceptors provided cover for bombers that destroyed Kryze Fortress.]] Around [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|19}} [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Gideon's remnant]] part of the fallen Empire possessed a force of TIE ships, including many interceptors, through the support of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]]. An [[Gideon's TIE/IN interceptor squadron|interceptor squadron]] supported the force of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]] that [[Bombing of Kryze Castle|targeted]] [[Kryze Fortress|Kryze Castle]] on [[Kalevala]]. [[Mandalorian]]s [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Din Djarin]], returning to Kelavala after their [[Mission to the Living Waters|mission to the Mines of Mandalore]], engaged the TIE ships until their true numbers were revealed. Faced with the many TIE ships and surpised, both retreated. Bo-Katan would eventually be able to reunite her forces and lead the [[Mandalorian resistance]] in an effort to [[Conflict on Mandalore|retake]] their homeworld. This effort lead them into conflict with Gideon's Imperial Remnant where they discovered that they operated out of a [[Mandalore Imperial base|secret base]] built on the planet which housed many TIE Interceptors. During the battle, these fighters saw action against the Mandalorians, including targeting [[Mandalorian fleet|their fleet]] in orbit. [[Axe Woves]] would make to their [[Gideon's light cruiser|stolen command ship]] and altered the fleet of the attack, allowing them to escape and bring reinforcements for the final effort to retake Mandalore while he commanded the light cruiser and engaged several TIE Interceptors and bombers. The cruiser sustained heavy damage and eventually fell from orbit hurling straight towards the Imperial Base with Axe Wolves escaping just before impact which saw the base's destruction, taking any grounded TIE Interceptors and other starfighters with it.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}} ===Legacy=== {{Main|TIE/ba Baron Space Superiority Interceptor}} [[File:TIEBaron-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|A TIE/ba interceptor was in use during the Cold War.]] By the time of the [[Cold War]], the [[First Order]] used the [[TIE/ba Baron Space Superiority Interceptor]], which served as its own version of a TIE interceptor.{{Resistance|The Recruit}} During the reign of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], the First Order also fielded the [[TIE/wi_interceptor|TIE/wi Interceptor]] and [[Kylo Ren's TIE whisper]].{{Film|IX}} ==Behind the scenes== The Databank entry for the TIE interceptor on [[StarWars.com]] states that it was first deployed sixteen [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[3 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Proclamation of the New Order|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] to [[19 BBY]]. As {{Databank|tie-interceptor|TIE Interceptor}} states the TIE/IN interceptor was first deployed sixteen [[Standard year|years]] after the Republic's fall, they must have been deployed in [[3 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' later showed the TIE interceptor being used by the Second Sister''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' in [[14 BBY]]. The mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' later established that the Second Sister's craft was a TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype. However, another TIE/IN is featured in ''Fallen Order'' on Kashyyyk. The status of this second TIE/IN has not been clarified. However, the [[Electronic Arts]] website provided an explanation for the 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] inconsistency, clarifying that year was only the ship's ''official'' deployment.
